description: This file defines the WebSocketClientHandler class, which manages WebSocket client connections, handshakes, message handling, and logging within the mockserver project.

classes.name: WebSocketClientHandler
classes.description: Handles WebSocket client events, including handshake, message processing, and exception handling, with integrated logging.

methods.name: WebSocketClientHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with logger, client ID, server address, context path, WebSocket client, and security flag.

methods.name: cleanContextPath
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats the context path for WebSocket URI.

methods.name: channelActive
methods.description: Initiates WebSocket handshake when channel becomes active.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Logs disconnection event when channel becomes inactive.

methods.description: Processes incoming messages, handling HTTP responses, WebSocket frames, and logging.
